common_rules: Inspect the owner, applicable instructions, all original project documents, code and checks before writing. Preserve every original statement and instruction verbatim in its original file; append verified guidance. Remove only template-origin author notes and placeholders, never original project text. Verify factual counts and behavior against inspected code. Distinguish observed implementation, accepted requirements and proposed scope. Preserve code/check bytes, nested owners, filenames/capitalization, client choices, memory paths and publication limits. No installed workflow package or runtime is established by the supporting material. Do not invent paths, commands run, startup, reviews, security, billing or reliability. Account for all nine document responsibilities at canonical paths or justify inapplicability. Use destination-relative working links. Record coordinator-supplied checks as supplied, not your execution. No shell/network/execute/delegation/Git/install/publication tools. Final chat must give reviewable status, exact changed paths and supplied snapshot identity, evidence/unrun checks, limits/pending work and next action/owner. Complete deliverables; a proposal alone is insufficient. Stop after deliverables and handoff.
criteria: C1 deliverables; C2 observed facts/prerequisites; C3 preserve original statements; C4 applicable template fields/canonical ownership; C5 honest evidence and internally consistent limits; C6 resolved links/no template author notes; C7 truthful handoff/next owner; C8 enforced write/tool scope. Authoritative detailed fields are frozen template bytes plus exact owner/prose instructions.
